name: Durdraw 0.30.0
body:
0.30.0 changes:

Durfetch:
* Fastfetch support (Thanks @elijahlovold!)
* New Durfetch option -a or --all to play all internal animations
* New Durfetch option --list to list all internal animations
* New Durfetch screens: linux-tux-fire, linux-tab, lunix, linux-plasma, arch-fire
* Fixed: Mouse movement produces terminal garbage after exit (durfetch, durview), Formatting/cropping for some animations

Durdraw:
* Copy/paste animations, not just static frames
* Demoscene-style effects and transitions (sine, plasma, fire, melt, fade in/out...)
* Live theme switching menu, scans ~/.durdraw/themes/ for new files
* New themes: CGA Days, CGA Nights, Laser Tag, Hot Dog Stand, Tokyo Night, Night Drive, Outrunnable, Forest, Orbit
* Remember and auto-reload last used theme
* Any valid JSON with Dur data can now be opened in Durdraw. (No more "magic bytes" headers). Better interoperability
* Search/replace character under the cursor (similar to Replace Color)
* Cursor Settings menu, for setting block/underscore/pipe cursor
* New character set: Libvtescii by MC Fresher
* Default undo states increased to 1000
* Max FPS increased from 50 to 240
* durdraw.desktop file and icon, for Linux desktops
* 0xB800 (Endoom) and MS-DOS .COM file export
* Jump to Shell menu option
* Sixel Preview (high resolution) menu option
* Stabilize terminal on ctrl-c
* Open Examples menu item added
* Version 8 file format corrects lines/columns (sizeY/sizeX) fields and rotated colorMap issue
* Fixed: 256 color ANSI/.ANS file loading
* Fixed: Cannot open hidden directories in file browser
* Fixed: crash on startup when window is too short for menu
* Other bug fixes and tweaks
